name: Design Research Methodology
description: Introduction to design research; quantitative research: paradigm, characteristics, values of quantitative research; methods: survey, longitudinal studies, experimental research, questionnaires and so on; qualitative research: paradigm, characteristics, values of qualitative research; methods: contextual inquiry, ethnographic method, participant observation, in- depth interview, focus groups, journal/document, visual research; mixed-methods research: participatory research, action research; heritage and material culture in India; ethics of design research.
